name: Raoul Dufy

summary.text: Raoul Dufy was a French painter associated with the Fauvist movement. He gained recognition for his vibrant and decorative style, which became popular in various forms, such as textile designs, and public building decorations.

25710737: Les Alliés (Allies) is a colour woodcut, in the form of a silk scarf, by Raoul Dufy created in 1914.
60492101: Trees in L'Estaque is an oil on canvas painting by French painter Raoul Dufy, from 1908. It is owned by the Musée national d'Art moderne, in Paris, but placed on loan to the Musée Cantini since 1987.
99899791: Pink Nude is a gouache painting on paper fixed on canvas by the French artist Raoul Dufy, from 1930. It is held in the collection of the Unterlinden Museum in Colmar, Alsace.
